notes.title: Darkwood
notes.content:
Dear Gluua Players,

Happy Halloween! 🎃 We are thrilled to announce an update for Gluua! Here's what you can expect in this exciting release:


 Darkwood:
Introducing Darkwood, a new environment featuring a mysterious ritual. Your mission is to investigate and banish the looming curse.

 New Ghost & Minigame:
A new ghost has arrived in Darkwood, and we've introduced an exciting minigame to test your skills and nerves.

 Inventory System:
We've implemented a new inventory system to enhance user-friendliness and support larger maps in upcoming updates. Managing items and resources will be a breeze as you prepare to face the horrors ahead.

 Equipment Upgrades:
Enjoy two new equipment upgrades, allowing you to customize your playstyle and strategy across all equipment categories.

 Bug Fixes & Optimization:
We've addressed various gameplay issues and optimized performance for a smoother and more enjoyable experience.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358947/2d8c244cf7fb72fdb25d8b63fcd943e41e2f74f4.png

We value your feedback! Share your thoughts and experiences with the Gluua community. Get ready to confront the unknown and break the curse in Darkwood.

Thank you for your unwavering support. Stay tuned for more updates and announcements from the Gluua team.

Warm regards,
The Gluua Team 🎮🎃

notes.title: Update 7/25
notes.content:
In this update, we intend to improve the overall stability of the game loop and quality of life.


 We have improved connection stability to address a bug where players were sometimes stuck on the loading screen. 
 GD1 has been reworked. 
 Fixed an issue where the camera was clipping through the local player's body.

notes.title: Update 7/24 - 2
notes.content:
In this update, we intend to finalize optimizations and address fatal bugs that caused crashes.


 Temporarily removed the exit sign from the workbench due to it sometimes causing crashes when interacted with.
 Film grain has been removed to provide a clearer visual.
 Attempting to fix a bug where the player starts the mission and randomly experiences fatal crashes.

notes.title: Update 07/24
notes.content:
In this update, we intend to finalize optimization for player equipment with some minor bug fixes.


 Fixed a bug where sometimes the player's screen blurred
 More GD1 and Flashlight iteration optimizations
 Attempt to improve visual quality for spirit world effect

notes.title: Update 07/22
notes.content:
In this update, we intend to improve overall stability and performance and introduce new systems to support upcoming maps in the near future.


 Main character optimizations to improve performance for multiplayer
 GhostEvents overall improvements
 Improved flashlight iteration performance
 Improved GD1 iteration performance
 Updated WhiteDress's hand spawn points

notes.title: Update 7/20
notes.content:
Gameplay

Added sprint and stamina system.
Increased Ghost Hunt's audio volume.


QoL Improvements

Improved FOV system to prevent camera clippings.
Scroll wheel now can be used to swap between types of equipment.


Bug fixes

Removed paranormal collisions that caused the player to stuck or pushed the player.
